correctness.rationale: Exact normalized monomial-basis coefficient expansion and generating-function identity yield S_m. Nonnegative Tonelli summation proves necessity and sufficiency for an S2 extension. Three gamma-ratio convolution regimes yield sharp powers and the beta-function coefficient; independent rational checks confirm combinatorial identities. Laplace moment asymptotics and integral test establish both logarithmic endpoints. No finite experiment was used as a universal proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 motivating study stops at boundedness. S2 membership is a natural, strictly stronger ideal-theoretic question; its exact moment norm identity, sharp dimension-versus-kernel transition at beta=n/2, independence from alpha, and double-critical log exponent r>1 on power-log measures provide a complete and mathematically meaningful family classification.
